about: After `record`, a copy step stands in for the writer rewording u1's copy in idea-tobias. `findings --failed` undoes u1 and u2. u2's copy leaves idea-mara. u1's copy line can't be found, so idea-tobias is left alone with the writer's line, and the miss is saved in .runs/{run-id}/undo-misses.json. Both units join the unit index as undone.
spec: plan-run-manager.md 04 Milestone 9 (undo moved in from Milestone 10)
readings: undo-misses.json names the unit as it reads in the unit index, 'b1-u1'.
A unit with an undo miss still joins the unit index as undone.
